note: The week on the Special Intensive Revision in a few sentences, written every Friday from the What's new entries of the seven days to that Friday. Each sentence links to the page that carries the fact, with that page's name as the label. Every figure in a sentence is a figure in one of the week's entries, and sources lists the entries each issue draws on.

paragraphs.text: On 29 October the Election Commission moved the final rolls to 30 November in Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Telangana and Nagaland and to 22 December in Delhi, at the request of the Chief Electoral Officers.
paragraphs.label: How the revision was run

paragraphs.text: In an affidavit of 26 October the Election Commission told the Supreme Court that all three SIR orders were unanimous and that Form 6 was not amended, while accepting that the declaration shown online with it could be read as an amendment, and on 27 October the Court gave the petitioners 10 days to answer it.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: At the Delhi hearing of 28 October the Supreme Court told the Commission orally not to hold electors to the 30 October cut-off, and no written order was reported.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: On 30 October the Supreme Court told the Commission to examine the bulk Form 7 applications in Uttar Pradesh that the petitioners say remain unresolved and to file a compliance report, and it declined to extend the time for Kerala's revision.
paragraphs.label: Protests and disputes

paragraphs.text: Meghalaya's final roll of 26 October holds 21,83,963 electors, a fall in the roll of 1,65,682 since the roll before the revision, and Karnataka's final roll of 27 October holds 4,54,55,689 general electors, a fall in the roll of 99,76,625 since the roll of 16 June.
paragraphs.label: Reserved seats, final rolls and borders

paragraphs.text: Telangana had held 92,08,443 hearings on notices by 29 October and found 50,690 electors ineligible, and Delhi had disposed of 31.2 lakh of its 33.1 lakh notices by 26 October.
paragraphs.label: How the revision was run

paragraphs.text: On the help page and on every state's page a box now shows whether claims and objections are open in that state today and when the final roll is due, and How the revision was run now lists the bulk Form 7 filings reported in each state.
paragraphs.label: Left off the roll? What to do

paragraphs.text: The INDIA bloc's 'public impeachment' of the Chief Election Commissioner was put back to 31 October because of rain, and BJP marches run in Rajasthan from 30 October to 5 November and in six Uttar Pradesh regions from 3 to 5 November.
paragraphs.label: Events
